questions.question:
What will come in place of the question mark (?) in the following equation, if ‘+’ and ‘−’ are interchanged and ‘×’ and ‘÷’ are interchanged?

100 × 4 + 11 ÷ 2 − 18 = ?
questions.solution:
Given - 100 × 4 + 11 ÷ 2 − 18 = ?

‘+’ and ‘−’ are interchanged and ‘×’ and ‘÷’ are interchanged.

BODMAS Rule:

 [IMAGE: https://lh4.googleusercontent.com/c0j5U9v2oJWEzSTKvdDLWZ5Zik3PBUXk-C9w3Ma990WH63rpQUfA7g-3wh_uT7CgFvFJ4jPGEeOw509FxSgfh78_HR9tDNZ9KitXdEveKsLaLMgPQf6YSDt1b775728JMVp9FIQs=s0] 

__**100 ÷ 4 **__− 11 × 2 + 18 = ?

25 − __**11 **____**×**____** 2 **__+ 18 = ?

25 − 22 + 18 = ?

__**25 + 18**__ − 22 = ?

43 − 22 = ?

21.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**

questions.question:
Read the given statement(s) and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusion(s) logically follow(s) from the statement(s).

Statements:

Some Blueberries are Melons.

All Melons are Grapefruits.

Conclusions:

I. No Blueberries are Grapefruits.

II. Some Grapefruits are Blueberries.
questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b55a1923f2a844cc97b993573c295f240b534fe3c9ace4482b16d1036f83ca13.png] 

Conclusions:

I. No Blueberries are Grapefruits.- False (Some Blueberries are Melons.All Melons are Grapefruits.Hence, it is false)

II. Some Grapefruits are Blueberries. - True (All Melons are Grapefruits.Some Blueberries are Melons. Some Grapefruits are Blueberries is True)

Only conclusion (II) follows. 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4"**
